title: VRUN CTW (the Corrupt The World demake) on the Master System (S0: the skeleton)
description: The Master System port of VRUN CTW, the NES demake (docs/projects/sega-vrun-ports-plan.md, S2: the view kept in 256x192, the HUD shrinks, PSG sound from the NES version). Today the S0 skeleton: a hello ROM (text, a frame counter, a cursor that Left / Right move) that proves the toolchain and BrokenDev's build / verify / compat. Built with SDCC 4.6.0 + devkitSMS (toolchains.json) in its live workspace PROJECTS/VRUN_CTW_SMS_dev (its own git, local only).

toolchain: SDCC 4.6.0 and devkitSMS 533ae57, pinned in toolchains.json (SMSlib and crt0 rebuilt from devkitSMS's sources by build.ps1)

steps.name: build
steps.note: build.ps1: SMSlib and crt0 rebuilt once (build/smslib-sms), sdcc -mz80, makesms; checks 'TMR SEGA' and the Master System export region code (4).

run.note: The skeleton: Left / Right move the cursor. Lite: the .sms opens in BrokenNes Lite's Master System (UAT/entrypoints/lite-sega.ps1 -Roms <folder with sms\vrun_ctw_sms.sms>).

memory.what: the vblank loop runs every frame
Right reached the pad and moved the cursor to the right edge (32 columns)

scenarios.why: the hello ROM on the Master System: it runs, draws and reads the pad

compat.what: The hello ROM on every Master System emulator BrokenDev has, from power-on and the same pad script, its state read by the build's symbols every frame.

scenarios.what: power-on, the text, Right held 30 frames

checks.what: the main loop runs (frame_count keeps changing)
Right moved the cursor to the right edge

comparison.what: S2: the Master System port against VRUN CTW on the NES (project vrun-nes, the mapper-30 build). The port is the same game code translated to C (tools/fab2c.py), so the tolerance is the plan's 'same events, small drift': rooms, items, deaths in the same order, positions within 4 pixels. Both sides 60 Hz, one tick a frame, time 0 = the first frame of the game (app_state 1). NESFab keeps each byte of a variable apart (player_x@1 = the whole pixel), the port's C variables are 8.8 fixed point (byte +1 = the pixel).

knownIssues: S0 skeleton only: the game is S2.
No hardware test on the user's Genesis flash cart yet (Master System through its backwards compatibility).
